description:
Screen a person's name against the OpenSanctions PEP (politically exposed
persons) dataset. Returns scored candidates; `pep` is true when any candidate
clears the 0.7 match threshold. `birth_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, or partial) and
`country` (name or ISO code) sharpen matching. `limit`: maximum candidates (1-10,
default 5). `ref`: optional reference of your own, echoed and recorded on the audit
trail. A PEP screen draws 5 requests from the monthly quota (it is a live, upstream-metered
query).
name: screen_pep
title: Screen for politically exposed persons
